ops.en: brotherly, friendly, and mutually supportive; also relating to a fraternity or fraternal society
ops.cn: 兄弟般友爱的；友好互助的；也指兄弟会或互助团体的

ops.note: Fraternal twins develop from two separate fertilized eggs.

ops.en: involving, obtained by, or intended as fraud or deliberate deception
ops.cn: 欺诈性的；通过欺诈取得的；以欺骗为目的的

ops.en: filled with, accompanied by, or likely to cause difficulty, danger, tension, or anxiety
ops.cn: 充满困难、危险、紧张或焦虑的；伴随着这些问题的

ops.meaning_cn: 充满、伴随着困难/危险/紧张等

ops.note: Also describes a situation or person marked by distress or anxiety.

ops.en: a state or period of wild excitement, uncontrolled activity, or intense agitation
ops.cn: 疯狂；狂热；一阵失控的兴奋、活动或激动

ops.meaning_cn: 处于疯狂、狂乱或极度激动的状态

ops.en: extremely cold in temperature
ops.cn: 严寒的；极冷的

ops.en: cold, unfriendly, or lacking warmth in manner or feeling
ops.cn: 冷淡的；不友好的；缺乏热情的

ops.en: formal: to criticize or denounce something severely and publicly
ops.cn: （正式）猛烈抨击；严厉公开谴责

ops.meaning_cn: 猛烈抨击、严厉谴责某事

ops.note: Specialist medical use: develop suddenly and with severe intensity.
Technical chemistry noun: a fulminic-acid salt or ester.

ops.en: excessive, insincere, or offensively flattering in praise, manner, or speech
ops.cn: 过分奉承的；虚情假意地赞美的

ops.en: full, comprehensive, or abundant; a newer neutral-positive use whose acceptability can depend on context
ops.cn: 充分的；全面的；丰富的（较新的中性或褒义用法，语境接受度有差异）
ops.usage_note: This newer positive use coexists with the traditional negative sense and can still be interpreted ambiguously.

ops.en: hard to please or excessively concerned with small details
ops.cn: 挑剔的；过分在意细节的

ops.en: overdecorated, cluttered, or excessively detailed in appearance
ops.cn: 装饰过度的；繁琐杂乱的

ops.note: Irritable or fretful is a secondary use, especially of children or behavior.

ops.en: unclear, vague, confused, or not sharply defined in thought or perception
ops.cn: 模糊的；含混的；思路不清的

ops.en: covered with soft short fibers, or appearing blurred and not sharp in outline
ops.cn: 有绒毛的；毛茸茸的；轮廓模糊不清的

ops.en: formal: to deny, contradict, or dispute a statement or fact
ops.cn: （正式）否认；反驳；质疑

ops.en: a very strong wind
ops.cn: 大风；强风

ops.meaning_cn: 阵阵大笑；爆发出的笑声

ops.en: brave and courageous, especially in danger, battle, or difficult action
ops.cn: 勇敢的；英勇的

ops.note: Also dignified, noble, or splendid in conduct.

ops.en: old-fashioned: courteously attentive or chivalrous toward women
ops.cn: （旧式）对女性殷勤有礼的；骑士风度的

ops.en: for a horse, or a rider/person, to move at a gallop
ops.cn: （马）飞奔；（骑手或人）疾驰

ops.note: Noun: the fast gait in which a horse moves with all four feet off the ground during part of the stride.
To ride at a galloping pace.
Transitive/causative: make a horse move at a gallop.

ops.en: to stare with the mouth open in surprise, shock, or amazement
ops.cn: 目瞪口呆地凝视；张口吃惊地看

ops.en: to be or become wide open
ops.cn: 裂开；张得很大；敞开

ops.en: to decorate or finish food or another thing by adding an accompaniment or ornamental detail
ops.cn: 给……加配菜或装饰；点缀

ops.meaning_cn: 用某物给食物或其他东西加配菜、装饰

ops.en: the troops stationed in a place to defend it
ops.cn: 驻军；守卫某地的部队

ops.en: to station troops in a place in order to defend it
ops.cn: 驻防；派兵驻守

ops.en: a fortified place, base, or town where troops are stationed
ops.cn: 驻军地；驻地；有驻军的要塞或基地

ops.en: excessively bright, showy, or ornate, often in a tasteless way
ops.cn: 花哨俗艳的；过分鲜艳招摇的

ops.note: Rare noun: a celebratory college reunion or feast in Britain.

ops.en: a precious or semiprecious stone that can be cut and polished, especially for jewelry
ops.cn: 宝石；可切割抛光用于珠宝的珍贵或半珍贵矿石

ops.en: an excellent, treasured, or especially delightful person or thing
ops.cn: 珍品；极好的人或事物；宝贝

ops.en: friendly, cheerful, warm, and pleasant in manner
ops.cn: 和蔼友善的；愉快亲切的

ops.note: Specialist anatomical sense: relating to the chin or lower jaw.

ops.en: polite, refined, and socially respectable in an elegant way, often with an affected or old-fashioned connotation
ops.cn: 文雅体面的；讲究上流礼仪的（常带做作或旧式色彩）
ops.usage_note: Often implies an affected concern with social respectability rather than purely neutral refinement.

ops.meaning_cn: 与某事密切相关且切题

ops.en: for a seed or spore to begin to grow or sprout
ops.cn: 发芽；萌发

ops.en: to cause a seed or spore to begin growing or sprouting
ops.cn: 使发芽；使萌发

ops.en: for an idea, plan, or feeling to begin to develop
ops.cn: （想法、计划或感情）萌生、逐渐形成

ops.en: horrifying, shocking, repellent, or extremely unpleasant
ops.cn: 可怕的；骇人的；极令人不快的

ops.en: informal: very bad or unpleasant
ops.cn: （非正式）糟糕透顶的；很不愉快的

ops.en: very pale and ill-looking
ops.cn: 面色惨白的；病容的

ops.en: a taunting, mocking, or insulting remark
ops.cn: 嘲讽；挖苦；讥讽的话

ops.en: to taunt, mock, or jeer at someone
ops.cn: 嘲弄；讥讽；挖苦

ops.value: gibe = taunt/mock. The spelling jibe can also occur for the taunt sense, but jibe with = agree/be consistent and nautical jibe are distinct use-space; do not treat jibe as an unrestricted spelling alias of this owner.

ops.en: to gather leftover grain or other produce after the main harvest
ops.cn: 拾取收割后遗留的谷物或农作物

ops.en: to obtain or gather information, facts, or understanding gradually, often from several sources
ops.cn: 逐步搜集、获取信息、事实或理解

ops.en: fluent, confident, and persuasive in speech in a way that seems shallow, insincere, or too easy
ops.cn: 能说会道却显得肤浅、油滑或不真诚的

ops.note: Superficially plausible or convincing without adequate depth.

ops.meaning_cn: 因某事而幸灾乐祸、沾沾自喜

ops.en: shiny, smooth, and reflecting light from the surface
ops.cn: 有光泽的；光滑发亮的

ops.en: slick, polished, and superficially attractive, sometimes more impressive in appearance than substance
ops.cn: 光鲜亮丽的；表面精致但可能华而不实的

ops.note: Noun: a photograph printed on smooth shiny paper.

ops.en: an excessive supply or amount of something, especially enough to depress prices or overwhelm demand
ops.cn: 供过于求；过量；尤指多到压低价格的供应

ops.en: to supply or fill a market with more of something than can be wanted or used
ops.cn: 使市场供应过剩；充斥

ops.meaning_cn: 使某物充斥市场、造成供应过剩

ops.en: to provoke, pressure, or urge someone into taking action
ops.cn: 刺激、逼迫或怂恿某人采取行动

ops.note: Literal use: prod or drive with a pointed stick.

ops.en: to struggle to understand, solve, or deal with a difficult problem, issue, or situation
ops.cn: 努力应对、处理或理解棘手问题

ops.meaning_cn: 努力处理、应对或理解某个难题

ops.note: Literal branch: grip, seize, or wrestle physically.

ops.en: unnecessary, unwarranted, or uncalled-for, especially when offensive, violent, or insulting
ops.cn: 无必要的；无端的；无正当理由的

ops.en: lacking sufficient cause or justification
ops.cn: 没有充分理由或正当依据的

ops.en: formal: given or done free of charge or without recompense
ops.cn: （正式）无偿的；免费的

ops.en: informal/evaluative: unpleasantly slick, sleazy, or ingratiating in appearance or manner
ops.cn: （评价性）油滑猥琐的；令人不快地谄媚圆滑的
